findings.issue: The guarded-transition actor_event is appended on its OWN tenant tx (PgSodSource writer / the slug->UUID adapter connect), NOT the approve tx — disclosed in the module doc-comment. This does not undermine CE-2: Step 5b (the only actor_event append) runs ONLY after a successful issuance, so on every failure/deny/dormant path NO actor_event is written and the 422 rollback leaves nothing orphaned. A residual orphan-event window would require the approve tx to roll back AFTER a successful runIssueKey; in practice the only post-effect work is the JSONB write-back (same tx) and the engine-drive runs AFTER commit — so the window is not reachable through the current path. Low severity, accepted as documented.
findings.suggestion: If a future path can roll back the approve tx after a successful issuance, thread the actor_event append onto the caller's tx (or move it after the write-back) so the guarded-transition record shares the effect's atomicity.
